rules: Each record was opened on its own source page; license, creator and location were read there.
Only the free Unsplash License and the Pexels License are used. Unsplash+ and Getty-credited items are excluded.
'people' is taken from the page text only. Faces and identifiability have NOT been checked by eye.
'downloads' lists a primary and a fallback URL; scripts/fetch-photos.php tries them in order.
